S081.name: Stress_Related_Maladaptive_Response
S081.description: Emotional or behavioral symptoms appearing in response to an identifiable stressor.

subtypes.With Depressed Mood: Symptoms mainly include low mood, tearfulness, or feelings of hopelessness.
subtypes.With Anxiety: Symptoms mainly include nervousness, worry, jitteriness, or separation anxiety.
subtypes.With Mixed Anxiety and Depressed Mood: A combination of depression and anxiety symptoms appears.
subtypes.With Disturbance of Conduct: Symptoms mainly involve violation of rules, truancy, vandalism, reckless driving, or fighting.
subtypes.With Mixed Disturbance of Emotions and C: Both emotional symptoms (depression, anxiety) and behavioral problems appear together.
subtypes.Unspecified: Maladaptive reactions not classified into the above types (e.g., physical complaints, social withdrawal).

symptom.disease_info: Adjustment Disorder is characterized by emotional or behavioral symptoms that develop in response to an identifiable stressor, typically within three months, and cause distress or functional impairment without meeting criteria for another primary mental disorder. The course is usually time-limited and closely tied to the stressor or its consequences, distinguishing it from more persistent mood, anxiety, or trauma-related disorders.

patient.stressor_event: Major change in the health or behavior of a family member
patient.stressor: Jamaal’s wife developed a sudden decline in mobility after a fall, turning his orderly retirement into a demanding caregiving schedule almost overnight. He initially responded by building charts, medication checklists, and home modifications, but across two months his emotional and behavioral response to the change increasingly overwhelmed the structure he relied on. He withdrew from STEM mentoring, left woodworking projects unfinished, neglected community commitments, and became unable to keep up with several household responsibilities that had always been routine for him. During a primary-care visit for his wife, the clinic social worker recognized how impaired Jamaal had become and arranged psychiatric care through the health system’s older-adult behavioral health service.

S081.name: Stress_Related_Maladaptive_Response
S081.description: Emotional or behavioral symptoms appearing in response to an identifiable stressor.
S081.manifestation: I came in because since my wife’s fall I’ve gone from being the man with the lists and the plan to sitting at the kitchen table staring at her medication chart, crying or snapping over nothing, and letting bills, mentoring calls, and even basic housework pile up like I just can’t make myself function.

add_requirements.Symptoms must develop within 3 months of: My wife’s fall was only about two months ago, and I started falling apart after the caregiving routine took over, not before it.
add_requirements.Within 6 months of the termination of th: There hasn’t really been an end to it yet—her mobility problems and the caregiving demands are still part of every day, so this has all been happening while the situation is ongoing.
add_requirements.functional_impairment: I’ve stopped showing up for mentoring and community commitments, and things I used to handle without thinking—bills, home upkeep, and basic household routines—are now slipping badly.
add_requirements.duration: This has been going on for about two months, since my wife’s fall changed everything at home.
